newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Datang issues shares to cover allotment.
newsitem.headline: Datang issues shares to cover allotment.

text.p: Beijing Datang Power Generation Co Ltd said on Tuesday it would issue 186.61 million new H-shares, or 3.61 percent of the enlarged share capital, to cover over-allocations in the United States.
The shares will be placed at HK$2.52 each and are expected to be listed on the Hong Kong stock exchange on March 26, the Chinese power supply concern said in a statement.
Global coordinator Morgan Stanley Asia Ltd had exercised an over-allotment option to require the company to issue the additional H-shares, it said.
H-shares are shares of mainland Chinese companies listed in Hong Kong.
The company said net proceeds of about HK$456 million would be used to purchase and to finance construction of power plants in Hebei province in northeastern China.
On completion, the total number of H-shares in issue would amount to 1.43 billion shares.
Beijing Datang Power was listed on March 21. Its shares closed HK$0.30 higher at HK$3.325 on Monday.
